name: Riedel Glas Manufaktur
kurzbeschreibung: Riedel glassworks in Kufstein captivates visitors with the Sinnfonie sensory exhibition, traditional mouth-blown glass craftsmanship, and wine glass design.
preis: Erwachsene ca. 12,00 €, Kinder unter 18 Jahren in Begleitung frei
beschreibung:
Überblick

World-renowned Riedel Glas, headquartered in the fortress town of Kufstein, has represented master craftsmanship and pioneering wine glass design for more than 265 years and eleven generations. In the 1950s, Claus J. Riedel revolutionized wine enjoyment by proving that the shape, size, and rim diameter of a glass fundamentally determine how aroma and flavour are perceived. At the Kufstein manufactory, the "Sinnfonie" multisensory experience immerses visitors in the ancient craft of turning fiery molten sand into exquisite lead-free crystal.

Route & Anforderungen

The self-guided tour begins in the "Sinnfonie" exhibition, highlighting the five human senses through interactive displays and light installations. Visitors then access the viewing gallery above the working glassworks floor. Looking down into the glowing furnaces, you can watch master artisans gather molten glass at over 1,000 degrees Celsius and blow world-famous decanters and stemware by hand using traditional wooden moulds and glassblowing pipes. The route is fully wheelchair-accessible via ramps and lifts, taking roughly one hour to explore.

Besuch & Anreise

The glassworks and Sinnfonie exhibition are open year-round, Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 16:00 (closed Sundays; please note there is no live glassblowing on Saturdays). Adult admission is roughly 12.00 Euro, while youths under 18 enter free when accompanied. Located in Kufstein, the site is accessed via the A12 motorway (exit Kufstein-Süd) with free parking on site. From Kufstein railway station, it is a 15-minute walk or a short local bus ride.

Tipps

Book a guided comparative glass-tasting workshop to experience firsthand how different glass shapes transform identical wines. The extensive factory outlet on site offers first-rate glassware and decanters.
